title.narrative: Second Ho Chi Minh City Environmental Sanitation Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve wastewater services in a sustainable manner in selected areas of Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) and increase awareness on sanitation.

The objective of the Second Ho Chi Minh City Environmental Sanitation Project for Vietnam is to improve wastewater services in a sustainable manner in selected areas of Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) and increase awareness on sanitation. The project consists of the following four components: (1) Interceptor component will be a large diameter that will convey the wastewater that is currently being discharged on the east side of the Saigon River without treatment to the wastewater treatment plant that will be constructed under the project. (2) Wastewater Treatment Plant component will treat the wastewater collected in the NLTN basin and in the D2 areas. (3) Sewerage in District 2 Area component will complement the larger flood protection measures for HCMC which are being planned by the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MARD. (4) Construction Supervision and Project.
